claim: GPT-2 small prefers the indirect object over the subject
published: mean logit diff 3.56; IO > S in 99.3% of prompts
criterion: mean logit diff > 2 and IO > S in > 90% of prompts

claim: Name movers (9.9, 9.6, 10.0) attend from END to the indirect object
ours: mean attention to IO 0.60 vs to S 0.09
criterion: attention to IO > 2× attention to S

claim: Negative name movers (10.7, 11.10) write against the answer
criterion: both heads have negative DLA on logit(IO) − logit(S)

published: circuit keeps 87% of the logit difference (§4)
ours: circuit-only logit diff 3.29 [3.12, 3.46] = 93% of full model
criterion: between 60% and 120% of the full model

claim: Knocking out the circuit breaks the task; random heads don't
published: circuit knockouts collapse performance; random heads matter little (§4)
ours: all 7 classes ablated → -1.27; 26 random heads → median 2.48
criterion: circuit knockout drops logit diff by > 70%, random median drops it by < 40%

ours: circuit heads kept only at S1+1 / S2 / END by class, everything else mean-ablated: logit diff 3.35 [3.17, 3.53] = 95% of full model (all-position circuit: 93%)
criterion: between 60% and 120% of the full model; partial 40–60% (pre-stated 2026-11-28)
